title: When the Summer Burns
author: Quentin Iversen
blurb: Rosalind Quintana, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
